issues.description: Method GroverKakuro.state_preparation: the template repository declares the third parameter with the name 'ancilla_register' while the solution repository and the problem statement/docs consistently refer to this parameter as 'auxiliary_register'. This naming mismatch (template: ancilla_register vs. solution/docs: auxiliary_register) can confuse students reading the docstring, copying examples, or trying to call the method by keyword. It does not change behavior for purely positional calls, but it is a naming inconsistency across authoritative artifacts and increases cognitive load and risk of mistakes when students compare template code to the solution or to the instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method parameter 'ancilla_register' to 'auxiliary_register' in GroverKakuro.state_preparation signature and update the method's docstring and any internal references to use 'auxiliary_register' so the template, solution, and problem statement use the same identifier. This preserves pedagogical intent while removing a small but real source of confusion.
